title: XOR cancellation
explanation: XOR is order-independent, so pair up the 5s first: (5 ^ 5) ^ 3 = 0 ^ 3 = 3. This cancellation is the entire trick behind Single Number and Missing Number.

title: Drill: count set bits
prompt: From memory: return the number of 1-bits in `n` (n ≥ 0) using the `x & (x - 1)` clear-lowest-bit loop — not Integer.bitCount.

solution.explanation: Each iteration erases exactly one set bit, so the loop runs `popcount(n)` times — faster than checking all 32 positions.

hints: `n &= (n - 1)` erases the lowest set bit; count until n is 0.

title: Drill: power of two?
prompt: From memory (clear-lowest-bit trick): return whether `n` is a power of two. A positive power of two has exactly one set bit, so `n & (n - 1)` clears it to 0.
hints: Guard `n > 0`, then `(n & (n - 1)) == 0` means a single set bit.
